simple.meaning: מִשְׁבָּר (mishbâr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a breaker (of the sea).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִשְׁבָּר (H4867) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 22:5, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, Psalms, Jonah.
